description: This file is a unit test class for the UtilHttp utility class, containing test methods for parsing URL parameters, handling composite parameter values, and related utility functions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilHttpTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the UtilHttp utility methods related to HTTP request parameter parsing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a mock HttpServletRequest before each test.

methods.name: basicGetPathInfoOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Tests extracting path info parameters from URL strings into a map.

methods.name: emptyGetPathInfoOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Tests behavior when getPathInfoOnlyParameterMap is called with null.

methods.name: filteredGetPathInfoOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Tests filtering of path info parameters.

methods.name: basicGetParameterMap
methods.description: Tests retrieval of parameter map from a HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: pathInfoOverrideGetParameterMap
methods.description: Tests overriding request parameters with path info segments.

methods.name: emptyParameterMap
methods.description: Tests behavior with empty parameter map and request method.

methods.name: basicMakeParamValueFromComposite
methods.description: Tests building a composite Timestamp parameter from request parameters.

methods.name: emptyTypeMakeParamValueFromComposite
methods.description: Tests handling of null composite type.

methods.name: ampmMakeParamValueFromComposite
methods.description: Tests handling of AM/PM time designations in composite parameters.

methods.name: basicMakeParamListWithSuffix
methods.description: Tests creating a list of parameter values with a suffix filter.

methods.name: additionalParamsMakeParamListWithSuffix
methods.description: Tests creating a list of parameter values with additional parameters and suffix filter.

methods.name: missingRequestMakeParamListWithSuffix
methods.description: Test to verify that passing null request throws NullPointerException.
